scripts.build: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html www/index.html && cp node_modules/@capacitor/core/dist/capacitor.js www/capacitor.js
scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android: npm run sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
